subject: Renewal & expansion pricing - volume step-ups, blended rates, new routes/models
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volume step-ups / blended rates)

Hi Samir — thanks for taking the call today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we can get a formal quote into Procurement:

Call highlights:
- Current monthly volume: ~6M tokens currently in prod (main model routes). Peak tests showed bursts to ~12M.
- Expansion ask: add two new routes (clinical-summarization model + patient-chat model) that we estimate will add ~8M tokens/mo in steady state.
- Target economics: your finance lead mentioned a target budget range of ~$80k–$120k/month for inference (high-level). You also said you want unit economics roughly in the ballpark of $8k–$12k per 1M tokens (depending on model mix).
- Renewal: 12-month renewal with staged volume step-ups (15M -> 30M -> 50M monthly) tied to blended-rate tiers.

What I will do next (actions):
1) Share an initial blended-rate proposal + example step-up schedule for 12/24/36 month commits (attached: acme_usage_mar2026.csv + draft pricing sheet).
2) Prepare a short one-pager showing unit economics (token mix / model routes impact) and recommended quantized model options to keep costs down.
3) Align with our legal on the redline process and provide a draft SOW/contract route for Procurement.

Can you confirm the steady-state add-on volume estimate (8M tokens/mo) and the budget range ($80k–$120k/mo) so I capture the right target $/1M token? Also, is Procurement the right team to receive the formal quote next?

Thanks — happy to hop on another 30-min call this week to walk through the blended tiers.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_usage_mar2026.csv (csv)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volume step-ups / blended rates)

Thanks Marissa — that recap looks right. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed volumes: steady-state additional routes expected ~9M tokens/month (range 7–11M). Peak seasonal could push monthly totals to ~45–55M during heavy periods.
- Budget: finance gave a running target of $80k–$120k/month but will stretch to $140k/month for committed multi-route adoption if unit economics look favorable.
- Target unit economics: preference for blended $/1M tokens between $9,000–$11,000 initially; ideally step down to ~$7,500–$8,500 at higher committed tiers.

Procurement is the right team for the formal quote (cc'd). Rachel will handle the PO and contract intake — she asked if you can provide:
1) a blended-rate scenario table (example at current 20M / 35M / 50M monthly)
2) an explicit note on model routing uplift (e.g., +5–10% cost for specialized clinical models)
3) redline-ready contract and expected lead time for onboarding credits/one-time setup fees.

We've attached an internal procurement note for context.

Samir
VP Product, Acme Health
[Attachment: acme_procurement_note_mar2026.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Mar 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volume step-ups / blended rates)

Appreciate the quick confirmation, Samir — agreed on next steps. Attached is a first-pass pricing sheet (redwood_pricing_volume_stepups_v2.xlsx) with three blended scenarios and a recommended step-up schedule. High-level summary below: 

Proposed blended tiers (example monthly committed bands):
- 0–19M: list/blend = $13,000 / 1M tokens
- 20–34M: blended offer = $11,000 / 1M tokens
- 35–49M: blended offer = $9,500 / 1M tokens
- 50M+: blended offer = $8,000 / 1M tokens

Step-ups & credits:
- Standard step-downs at milestone billing months (30-day observation window); pricing adjusts first full billing cycle after milestone is reached.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $10k credit for migration + priority support (applied to first invoice) if you commit to 12-month minimum and 30M+ expected within quarter 2.

Model routing uplift:
- Clinical-specialized model routes: +8% cost uplift over blended base (due to higher compute and lower batching efficiency).
- Patient-chat lightweight routes: neutral to -5% (better batching, served on quantized variants).

Example unit economics (illustrative):
- If you hit 35M/mo with a 60/40 split main:specialized, blended $/1M ~ $9,960 (including uplift on 40% of tokens).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send a short pricing summary + one-pager for Procurement (toc + blended table).
2) Legal will prepare a redline-ready contract; once Procurement confirms, we'll circulate for review (I expect 3–5 business days to get an initial redline back).
3) Schedule a 30-min pricing review with Rachel + Samir + Michael + Vivek this week — Thu/Fri windows work for our team.

Let me know which blended scenario you'd like formalized into a quote. If you want, we can offer a 12% discount off list across the 20–34M band for a signed 12-month commit (I can confirm margin/approval with Michael + Vivek).

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_volume_stepups_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap: renewal + expansion (volume step-ups / blended rates) — internal alignment

Internal — looping you in with Samir's confirmed numbers and Procurement on the thread. Key asks from Acme:
- Steady-state add-on ~9M tokens/mo (7–11M range). Peak totals could reach 45–55M/mo.
- Target blended $/1M: initial $9k–$11k, step down to ~$7.5k–$8.5k at higher tiers.
- Procurement requests: blended-rate table at 20/35/50M, explicit model routing uplift note, redline-ready contract.

I proposed the tiers in the pricing sheet and floated a 12% discount for 12-month commits on the 20–34M band plus a $10k onboarding credit for commitments that hit 30M+ in Q2. Samir is open but needs the formal numbers for Procurement.

Can you confirm: 1) approval to offer 12% off list on the 20–34M band (subject to a 12-month commit) and 2) approval of the $10k onboarding credit? Also confirm whether we can absorb a 8% clinical uplift (i.e., route-level surcharge) or if we should instead bake that into the blended tiers.

If approved, I'll finalize the quote and send to Rachel for PO intake.

Thanks — Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
